name: boss-1
about: Boss Rush: Product Pusher (a salesman robot in a plated suit with a briefcase). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss01-pusher-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); ten clips retargeted from Tripo's presets; parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
